question: Which of the following cell organelles are NOT present in animal cell?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Plastids__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **An organelles is a subcellular structure** that has one or more specific jobs to perform in the cell.
 
• **An animal cell is a type of eukaryotic cell** that lacks a cell wall and has a true, membrane-bound nucleus along with other cellular organelles.
 
• Plastids are found in all plant cells and in euglenoids and not in animal cells.<span style="font-size:14px;"
